**Binary MiB**, despite the passport field being named `max_file_size_mb`.

The validator converts it with Rails’ `.megabytes` (`1,048,576` bytes) and rejects files only when `document.file_size > limit`: [validate_documents.rb](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export/validate_documents.rb:112).

Thus, setting `max_file_size_mb: 50` enforces **52,428,800 bytes (50 MiB)**. A file exactly at that limit passes the size check.
